title: the prefix `try` propagation marker is retired: use Result.unwrap()
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Inference': 'VibeLang MUST NOT add a general throws clause, !T marker, prefix try expression, or postfix Result-recovery expression.' docs/DECISIONS.md 'Typed failures' (Locked) says the same. The property-access spelling Result.try(...) is a different thing and stays legal; 01-result-lifting/result-try-adapts-a-throwing-body pins it, and the scanner distinguishes them by the preceding '.' token.
